title: Polynomial Classification Game
description: An interactive p5.js MicroSim where students classify algebraic expressions as monomials, binomials, trinomials, or non-polynomials through a gamified quiz format with progressive difficulty levels.
creator: Claude AI
subject: Algebra
learningObjectives: Count the terms in an algebraic expression by identifying parts separated by + and - signs
Classify expressions as monomials, binomials, or trinomials based on their number of terms
Identify non-polynomials by detecting negative, fractional, or non-integer exponents such as 1/x and sqrt(x)
Distinguish a negative coefficient from a subtraction between terms when counting terms
Apply polynomial vocabulary to multi-variable expressions like x^2y + xy^2
